origin: Synthetic model, not an incident log or database runtime reproduction.
safetyRule: Same-generation work cleared before death may finish. Clearance for generation 1 must not affect generation 2 at a reused address.

cases.mechanism: A lock snapshot and earlier external identity observation do not protect ReadIdentity through ApplyEffect. Backend death releases the lock; external replacement need not obey the SQL session lock.
cases.expectedOutcome: counterexample: NoStaleEffect; identify unprotected observation-to-effect interval, including replacement before generation publication

cases.mechanism: Recording matching old tokens is not a current-generation comparison at effect time.
The pinned immutable object remains generation 1, but the effect resolves a reusable address now owned by generation 2. No operation binds the pin to current ownership.
cases.expectedOutcome: counterexample: NoStaleEffect; pin alone does not establish current-address ownership

cases.mechanism: A same-store conditional update compares authoritative generation and applies the write in one indivisible operation. Every reassignment updates the same authoritative row in that store.
cases.expectedOutcome: NoStaleEffect passes; supported-under-assumptions, not production proof

cases.mechanism: The resource service rejects old generations at the actual effect point, independent of delayed SQL generation publication.
cases.expectedOutcome: NoStaleEffect passes under the stated service enforcement assumption

cases.mechanism: No replacement occurs, so the conditional write remains allowed despite both deaths. Negated reachability is not a safety property.
cases.expectedOutcome: counterexample: NoCompletion witnesses permitted completion on generation 1
